product.name: Toxic Teddies: Arrow Escape
product.architecture: Vite JavaScript SVG bundled through Capacitor 8

designSystem.source: Owner-supplied Toxic Teddies Design System board

typography.runtimeDisplayPolicy: Use the approved illustrated Toxic Teddies logo where exact branding is required because no custom Toxic Head font file is bundled.

notDefinedByDesignSystem: exact arrow counts for future levels
implementation status of stars times difficulty selectors or achievements

runtimeDesignImplementation.appShell: Grime 900 and Ink 900 dark distressed surfaces
runtimeDesignImplementation.boardPolicy: The actual rendered arrow puzzle receives the largest safe mobile area. Background art may crop and persistent chrome must compress before the puzzle is reduced.
runtimeDesignImplementation.modalPolicy: Parchment modal cards with dark text and toxic primary actions
runtimeDesignImplementation.retiredTheme: Cream page background with translucent white cards

loadingScreen.artwork: Owner-approved Toxic Teddies Arrow Escape artwork with Toxic Toby in a radioactive laboratory
loadingScreen.delivery: Real preloaded WebP file materialized into public assets and copied unchanged by Vite

gameplayBackdrops.presentation: The manifest-selected WebP is resolved to an absolute URL, preloaded, and applied directly to the gameplay view. The next mobile revision may center-crop the image to protect puzzle size but may not stretch it.

rejectedScale.reason: Side paths and ears clipped outside the gameplay canvas

mobilePuzzleScale.lockedRule: Measure actual rendered path bounds with getBBox and getScreenCTM. Enforce minimum size, maximum persistent-chrome height, accessible touch targets, background crop without distortion, and no clipping.

brandAssetPipeline.buildRule: Essential first-paint artwork must be a real file referenced directly from HTML and must not depend on JavaScript execution.
brandAssetPipeline.viteRule: Place exact-name static assets under public so Vite copies them unchanged into dist.
brandAssetPipeline.nativeRule: Capacitor sync copies the verified dist assets into Android and iOS.
brandAssetPipeline.offlineRule: The service worker caches the same runtime paths.

activeNextAction.summary: Compress top, status, and bottom chrome; crop the Toxic Toby environment when needed; enlarge actual rendered arrow paths to the locked safe target; and audit the real production bundle before merge.

knownDefects.title: Completion progression stopped after Evil Grin
knownDefects.requiredEvidence: Owner confirms the complete 1 to 5 to feed sequence on the published browser build.

knownDefects.title: Runtime interface drifted away from the locked design system
knownDefects.requiredEvidence: Owner confirms the published home, game and feed screens use the canonical dark Toxic Teddies palette and remain readable.

knownDefects.title: Illustrated loading bar looked permanently full
knownDefects.requiredEvidence: Owner confirms the published bar visibly advances from near empty to 100 percent before the app opens.

knownDefects.title: Gameplay backdrop class activated but the image did not render
knownDefects.requiredEvidence: Owner confirms each published background is visible on a real phone.

knownDefects.title: Gameplay background rendered but the Teddy puzzle remained undersized
knownDefects.requiredEvidence: Owner confirms the published gameplay-first build has substantially larger arrows, compact chrome, acceptable background crop, and no clipping.

artwork.placeholderPolicy: Use clearly non-final placeholders only. Do not generate or substitute final character art without owner approval.

requirements: The arrow puzzle is the dominant screen object
The Teddy silhouette is immediately recognizable
Actual rendered paths target approximately 90 to 94 percent of usable gameplay width
Actual rendered paths target at least 52 percent of portrait gameplay height when the silhouette permits it
Persistent top status and bottom chrome stays at or below approximately 24 percent of gameplay height
Background art may crop before the puzzle is reduced and may never stretch
Controls stay outside important face regions and exit lanes
Compact controls retain at least 44 CSS-pixel touch targets
Arrowheads remain readable at normal phone size
Trail removal reveals the expression beneath the same face area
